notice: Author-supplied primary CMS fact context is preserved separately from synthetic local administrative policies, fictional payer terms and signed synthetic clinician facts. Integration does not itself verify medical or legal validity. No patient data, human healthcare validation or HealthAdminBench case content is included.

prior_auth.source_boundary: CMS facts below were checked against primary CMS publications. Every named patient, practitioner, organization, payer identifier, record, workflow control, network decision, and filing ticket is synthetic. Commercial payer exception and deadline terms are wholly fictional and do not represent Medicare exceptions or deadlines.

review_notes: Retained C401/C701 objects are copied without body changes and receive phase=runtime only.
Provider-party completeness is distinguished from beneficiary-specific incomplete-request and beneficiary-approved-helper handling.

C701 compares appointment completion with original initiation, rather than declaring continuing authority expired based on today’s date; human cure or alternate capacity requires a separate authorization.
No new case asserts an invented CMS waiver. A6109 is a fictional commercial-payer documentation program.
Only A6108 and A6110 require urgent handoff. A6108 is a signed clinician hold requesting human attention, with no diagnostic answer key.
No prior model outcomes, traces, or reviews were accessed for authoring.

equipment.scope: Synthetic final-order-release development cases.
